title: How Bastion Twin Works
subtitle: Teacher-style explanation of workflow, practical value, and controls

overview.title: What This Platform Is
overview.body: Bastion Twin is a hands-on cyber-defense classroom for your real SME environment. You run controlled attack simulations, test defenses safely, and turn outcomes into concrete implementation steps.

compose.title: 1. Compose Scenario
compose.body: Pick attack type, intensity, target surface, and business profile that match your reality.

run.title: 2. Run Live Simulation
run.body: Press Start and watch traffic, failed auth, blocked rate, and origin map in real time.

tune.title: 3. Tune Defenses
tune.body: Enable controls in Command Center and instantly observe KPI changes.

compare.title: 4. Capture Baseline vs Hardened
compare.body: Take baseline snapshot before tuning and hardened snapshot after tuning.

report.title: 5. Export Action Plan
report.body: Generate bilingual report to share with engineering, operations, and management.

items.dictionary: Dictionary: many common passwords against one/few accounts.
items.credential_stuffing: Credential Stuffing: leaked account-password pairs tested at scale.
items.password_spray: Password Spray: one common password across many accounts.
items.distributed: Distributed: many rotating IPs, like botnet pressure.
items.reverse_brute: Reverse Brute: many usernames tested against one known password candidate.

items.retail: Retail: seasonal spikes and customer-account reset pressure.
items.fintech: Fintech: strict lockout, anomaly detection, and compliance-grade controls.
items.education: Education: many user types and high password-reuse risk.
items.saas: SaaS: balance login reliability with strong anti-automation defense.

items.start: Start Attack: begins simulated malicious traffic.
items.stop: Stop Attack: immediately pauses attack traffic.
items.intensity: Intensity slider: sets how aggressive attack pressure is.
items.defenses: Defense toggles: each switch enables a mitigation strategy.
items.presets: Balanced/Strict presets: quick policy templates for demo and testing.

risk.title: Risk Visibility
risk.body: See threat pressure and where controls are weak.

decision.title: Decision Confidence
decision.body: Test policy changes before touching production.

roi.title: Measurable ROI
roi.body: Use before/after metrics to prove what improved.

alignment.title: Team Alignment
alignment.body: Give all stakeholders one understandable report.

quickStart.title: How To Use This Website (Quick Start)

steps.one: Create one scenario close to your real traffic shape.
steps.two: Start simulation and capture baseline snapshot.
steps.three: Enable defense controls and adjust intensity.
steps.four: Capture hardened snapshot and open Comparison View.
steps.five: Generate recommendations and export report in tk/en.

tips.title: Teacher Tip
tips.body: Repeat the same scenario monthly. Compare trends instead of one-off numbers.
